note: RV sites on a working farm a few minutes east of Lethbridge (85021 Range Road 211), off Highway 3; quiet country setting with no traffic noise. Self-contained RVs only, no tents; units may be no more than 20 years old. No open fires (propane fire pits allowed). Pets on leash, never left alone. The farm also rents four furnished cottages and sells hay and straw. --Claude
